title: Accelerator swipeboard + microflip onboarding assets for Optimize toolkit
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a small gallery of onboarding assets that explain batching, KV-caching, and quantization recommendations inside the Optimize toolkit. Primary interaction pattern: an "accelerator swipeboard" (horizontal card strip) with microflip cards for quick technical tooltips and an inline live-preview screenshot frame that shows token cost and latency hints. Assets should be usable for the Console tour, the quickstart modal, and the docs hero section.
deliverables: Figma: accelerator-swipeboard master file with 8 card states (default/hover/active/success/error)
Figma: microflip card component library (front: short heuristic, back: expanded advice + example)
3 annotated screenshots (desktop, tablet, mobile) showing live-preview with cost & latency overlay
Exported SVG components and tokens for engineering handoff
Microcopy file with 6 variants for A/B test
acceptance_criteria: Cards explain batching, prefix caching, and quantization in <= 22 words on first glance
Back of microflip shows concrete next-step (toggle, recommended quant profile) and link to deeper docs
Screenshots include realistic token counts and latency numbers pulled from staging telemetry (see attachments)
Engineering can implement components from exported SVGs + tokens without additional assets
PM and Eng sign-off on accuracy of cost/latency hints
design_notes: Use progressive disclosure: front of card keeps microcopy minimal, back contains short code snippets or config example
Color system follows Console brand tokens; success states use green-600, warnings yellow-500, neutral backgrounds for microcards
Live-preview overlay must be legible over variable model outputs; include semi-opaque gradient behind metrics
Prefer a 3-up default viewport for desktop hero; mobile assets use stacked vertical swipeboard behavior
Quant UI snippets should surface common profiles (int8, int4, awq) and recommended workload types
Accessibility: all cards must have 16px min readable font and sufficient contrast for key texts
screenshot_checklist: Desktop hero with swipeboard visible and card #2 expanded
Mobile narrow with microflip engaged (back face visible) and CTA in view
Console live-preview showing a sample prompt, token count, estimated cost and latency overlay
A/B variant screenshot with compact quant toggle vs full quant panel
Annotated screenshot for docs with callouts to each control

decisions: Microflip cards will show a 1-line heuristic on the front and a 2-line suggested action on the back to keep swipeboard density high
Cost and latency overlays will present ranges (p50/p95) pulled from staging; absolute numbers will be annotated as 'est.'
We will ship two A/B microcopy variants (concise vs explanatory) and measure click-through to 'Apply recommendation'
Accessibility-first typography and contrast decisions supersede decorative visuals for microflip backs
